limitations: This is one frozen task and one model run per mode, not a statistically powered benchmark.
Rubric scores indicate observable deliverable coverage; they do not prove scientific truth or causal correctness.
For a stronger evaluation, repeat across source-backed papers, domains, seeds, and independently adjudicated gold outputs.
